purpose: Rights, privacy and publication gates for corpus import/export and public search.

import_gate.title: 匯入前確認內容權利
import_gate.message: LOC 預設只匯入你本人創作、本人發表或你有明確權利處理的內容。請勿匯入私訊、MSN／Messenger 對話、第三方文章、未取得同意的共同創作，或其他涉及他人隱私與著作權的資料。
confirmations: 我確認主要內容由我本人創作，或我有權進行整理與索引。
我確認此資料不包含未經同意的私人通訊或第三方敏感內容。
若資料包含共同作者、引用或他人內容，我會標記為 review_required，而不是直接公開。

export_gate.title: 匯出／公開前確認
export_gate.message: 匯出檔可能包含原文、時間、來源與分析標籤。只有 rights_status=cleared 且允許公開的內容，才應進入公開下載、Demo 或對外搜尋結果。
confirmations: 我確認本次匯出不包含 private 或 restricted 內容。
我確認第三方內容已排除，或已完成權利審查。
我了解平台匯出檔可取得，不代表其中所有內容都可再次公開。

publication_gate.title: 公開展示權利檢查
publication_gate.rule: Public display/search requires valid ownership or permission + visibility=public + rights_status=cleared.

provenance_rule: Platform export availability does not grant reuse rights to all contained content.
historical_rule: Historical records remain immutable evidence; rights metadata and interpretation may change without rewriting the original record.

public_access_control.principle: Public search is not a bulk corpus export endpoint.
controls: Do not expose full corpus text through sequential browse/list endpoints.
Return bounded previews for catalog browsing.
Keep full-text result counts small and query-driven.
Owner/private export, if added later, must require an authenticated rights gate.
robots.txt or copyright notices are advisory and do not replace access controls.
Do not expose the complete canonical Graph by calling /search/graph without a center node.

boundary_model.principle: Rights governance is a domain boundary, not a moral ranking of content.
boundary_model.crossing_rule: Moving data across a visibility/rights boundary requires an explicit governed action; import or storage alone never implies publication permission.

dispute_rule: A rights or attribution objection creates a review/dispute state; disputed content should not be silently deleted or publicly promoted while unresolved.
